Cognitive Tutor practice logs

Source: R/data-kt.R
cognitive_tutor.Rd

Practice logs from a Cognitive Tutor for middle and high school mathematics: 587 students' first attempts at 16,857 problem steps, each tagged with one of 12 knowledge components (such as "Calculate unit rate" or "Plot pi"). This is the sample used in the pyBKT examples and in Bulut et al. (2023), and it fits mv_kt_fit() as it is.

Usage

cognitive_tutor

Format

A tibble with 16,857 rows and 7 columns:

student

anonymized student id.

problem

the problem the step belongs to.

step

the step of the problem.

skill

the knowledge component of the step.

correct

1 if the first attempt at the step was correct, 0 otherwise.

opportunity

the student's attempt number on the skill.

time

the time of the first attempt (UTC).

Source

data/ct.csv of the pyBKT-examples repository (https://github.com/CAHLR/pyBKT-examples), a sample of the Cognitive Tutor data released through the PSLC DataShop for the KDD Cup 2010 (Stamper et al., 2010). The script is data-raw/kt.R in the package's GitHub repository.

References

Bulut, O., Shin, J., Yildirim-Erbasli, S. N., Gorgun, G., & Pardos, Z. A. (2023). An introduction to Bayesian knowledge tracing with pyBKT. Psych, 5(3), 770-786. doi:10.3390/psych5030050

Stamper, J., Niculescu-Mizil, A., Ritter, S., Gordon, G. J., & Koedinger, K. R. (2010). Challenge data sets from KDD Cup 2010. PSLC DataShop. https://pslcdatashop.web.cmu.edu/KDDCup/

See also

mv_kt_fit()

Examples

head(cognitive_tutor)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#>   student problem    step          skill correct opportunity time               
#>   <chr>   <chr>      <chr>         <chr>   <int>       <int> <dttm>             
#> 1 745Yh   RATIO2-001 SimplifiedNu… Calc…       1           1 2006-11-14 10:18:05
#> 2 745Yh   RATIO2-001 SimplifiedNu… Calc…       0           2 2006-11-14 10:18:17
#> 3 745Yh   RATIO2-012 SimplifiedNu… Calc…       0           3 2006-11-14 10:50:57
#> 4 745Yh   RATIO2-012 SimplifiedNu… Calc…       1           4 2006-11-14 10:51:14

#> 6 745Yh   RATIO2-054 SimplifiedNu… Calc…       1           6 2006-11-28 09:54:14
